A source having volume flow rate 2.5 m<sup>3</sup>/sec at the origin and a uniform flow at 5 m/sec 18   
are superimposed. The half body which is formed has a maximum width of 2.lm.   
Calculate;   
(i) The location of stagnation point   
(ii) Width of the body at the origin and   
(iii) The velocity at (0.7,rt/2).
